text: のしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ　きみは　なかまに　はいったら　つぶれそうだな…　かわりに　きみの　ポケモンに　のしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？

structure.jp: のしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ
structure.en: we're having a Body Slam contest

structure.jp: きみは　なかまに　はいったら

structure.en: you look like you'd get squashed...

structure.jp: きみの　ポケモンに　のしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？
structure.en: shall I teach Body Slam to your Pokémon?

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そうだ on the short stem of a verb says it looks like that will happen. つぶれそうだ = 'you look like you'd get squashed'.

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: おしえて　やろっか
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form says you do something for someone, said from above; やろっか is short for やろうか 'shall I?'. おしえて やろっか = 'shall I teach it for you?'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing happens. はいったら = 'if you joined'.
